personal.name: Kaushika Degekar Gulbarga
personal.title: Machine Learning Engineer | MS CS (AI) @ USC
personal.shortBio: Hi, I'm Kaushika. I'm a Master's student in Computer Science (AI) at USC, graduating May 2027. I build and evaluate machine learning systems, from fine-tuned LLMs and deep learning experiments to multi-agent pipelines and predictive models on business data. Before USC, I was a Software Engineer at Micron Technology, where I turned engineering data into dashboards and automated workflows.

work.title: Software Engineer I
highlights: Automated internal engineering workflows using SQL Server and PowerShell, reducing manual effort across project management processes
Built interactive Power BI dashboards consolidating project portfolio metrics so project managers could track project health, resource utilization and delivery progress
Digitized gate review processes with Power Apps and Power Automate, streamlining approvals across cross-functional engineering teams

projects.title: Medical LLM Hallucination Detection using Cross-Critique
description: Designed a dual-agent medical QA pipeline and a controlled 4-condition experiment comparing self-critique vs. cross-critique on MedMCQA and PubMedQA

Fine-tuned Mistral-7B Generator and Critic adapters with LoRA/QLoRA (4-bit) on a single T4 GPU; trained the Critic on 50K PubMedQA claim-evidence pairs with BM25 hard negatives, reaching 79.6% held-out accuracy

Defined Correction Gain and False Correction Rate metrics; cross-critique raised accuracy to 66.3% (vs. 62.4% baseline) and cut false corrections from 14.6% to 4.9%, a statistically significant gain (p < 0.05, McNemar's test)

projects.title: Activation Sparsity & Regularization in Convolutional Networks
description: Ran a controlled study of 4 activation functions (ReLU, GELU, SiLU, SwiGLU) crossed with 3 regularizers (dropout, weight decay, stochastic depth) on ResNet-20 trained on CIFAR-100, averaging 200-epoch runs over 2 random seeds
Evaluated both clean accuracy and corruption robustness on CIFAR-100-C to analyze how activation sparsity interacts with explicit regularization
Found weight decay was the best regularizer for every activation, improving top-1 accuracy by 4.7 to 6.3 points over baseline, with a best result of 68.54% (SiLU)
Diagnosed training divergence in ReLU² models as gradient explosion across all configurations

projects.title: Decentralized Coordination in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
description: Built predictive models on business datasets using H2O AutoML, cutting business insight generation time by over 95%
Engineered a decentralized multi-agent system in LangGraph with peer-to-peer coordination and no central controller, improving fault tolerance
Designed agent workflows, task routing and shared context for specialized analytics, web search and orchestration agents

projects.title: Patent Search Optimization
description: Built a Flask web app that returns the most relevant patents for a free-text idea title and description
Extracted key phrases with TextRank (pytextrank, spaCy, NetworkX) and NLTK preprocessing to turn idea descriptions into targeted search queries
Integrated the Google Custom Search JSON API to retrieve and display matching patents

projects.title: Automatic Reminder Generation System (Published)
description: Developed an NLP pipeline that detects and extracts reminder intents from real-time conversations using speech-to-text and natural language understanding
Achieved 98% reminder detection accuracy by combining AssemblyAI speech recognition with custom post-processing and intent extraction
Published in the 3rd International Conference on Cognitive and Intelligent Computing
